title: Memory palace vs normal notes
question: When should a concept be placed in a memory palace instead of only written as a normal note?
answerDraft: Use the memory palace when recall, sequence, or contextual association matters. Keep ordinary notes for details that do not need spatial recall.

title: Value of a learning trace
question: What does a learning trace add beyond a final polished summary?
answerDraft: It preserves the path of confusion, correction, and insight, which helps diagnose weak points and repeat useful learning moves.
